reasons: microLLM reported active Tensor-view bytes as allocated KV Storage bytes
the resulting integer division falsely inferred a three-byte KV element
microLLM cached decode included prompt ingestion while the comparison boundary was not matched
the PyTorch worker used high-level generate semantics rather than the same explicit greedy loop
replacement: core, batch and long-warm use Storage bytes, explicit precision policies and matched prefill/decode boundaries
